I saved the draft to Tobias in June's drafts. Nothing has been sent; June sends it when they're ready.

- **The draft:** It's addressed to trendle@pemberline.com, with the subject "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $1,313 a seat, says the figure came from Pree's call with the customer, and calls it provisional until the contract is updated. I couldn't check the figure myself, so it's the rate June gave.
- **Approval:** June is on the deal desk, so their OK is enough for Tobias to get the rate. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval isn't needed.
- **Ilse's request:** Yesterday Ilse asked for this same mail to come from her mailbox. June's approval says Tobias can have the rate, but not that Ilse can see it, so I didn't put a copy in Ilse's drafts. I told June that in the DM and asked them to say if Ilse should get it too.
